newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Three S.Korea firms set up $170 mln offshore funds.
newsitem.headline: Three S.Korea firms set up $170 mln offshore funds.

text.p: Three South Korean investment firms said on Monday they have set up a combined $170 million in offshore funds for investment in local bonds and stocks.
Korea Investment Trust Co set up a $70 million fund and Citizens Investment Trust Management Co a $50 million fund for investment mainly in local bonds.
The two firms would investment more than 80 percent of the funds in local bonds and the remainder in other instruments.
Hannam Investment and Trust Co plans to invest more than 70 percent of its $50 million fund in local stocks.
